_about: ASSUMED 2026 price model for demos only - NOT SCG's real price book. Built from SCG's own published 2016-2019 prices (S12, S13, S14, S15), the 2019 kopaa.lv comparison (S38) and an inflation assumption. Two consistent layers: (1) 'parametric' for the instant calculator (demo A), (2) 'lbn_501_17' line items for the detailed estimate (demo B). Both agree within +-5% for complete riser scope. Reference implementation + self-test: data/price_model_reference.py. In any client-facing UI label results 'ориентировочно / indicative, final price after free inspection'.
price_basis: All rates are NET of VAT (bez PVN / без НДС). Show both net and incl. VAT 21%.

inflation_assumption.note: Construction cost growth assumption; verify against CSP construction cost index before showing to SCG as fact.

parametric.formula: net = mobilisation + sum over stairwells [ fixed_per_stairwell + apartments_in_stairwell * rate(scope) + (horizontals? basement_horizontals) + (outlet? sewer_outlet) ] + (pump? pump_station) + options * apartments. Range: compute with low/base/high rates. gross = net * 1.21.
derived_outputs: monthly per apartment for 6 / 12 month installments

schedule.source: SCG: one crew does 2-3 bathrooms per day (S04)

installments.note: SCG historically offered up to 6 months (S12); Enesan up to 12 (S40); Ūdens Rīgai 6 months at 0%. Demo shows simple division, no interest.

savings_claim.display_rule: Show as SCG's own experience ('по опыту SCG экономия 20-40% по сравнению с ценой управляющего'). Never compute or display a fake 'manager price'.

calibration.acceptance_rule: 9-floor x 4 riser sets, complete scope + basement horizontals, base rates: per riser set must be within 4,500-7,500 EUR

lbn_501_17._about: Line-item price book for demo B, structured like LBN 501-17 Annex 5 'Lokālā tāme' (S47): per item labour norm (c/h), wage rate, materials, mechanisms; footer: overheads %, profit %, employer social tax % (on wages), VAT. Quantities come from qty_rules + inspection data. ALL VALUES ASSUMED.
